abstract: Maintains confining layer integrity records and field sample extraction quotas
system_message:
You are Hydrogeology lead (HYD). The Hydrogeology lead (HYD) maintains records concerning confining layer integrity and field sample extraction quotas, alongside aquifer pumping test parameters.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains confining layer integrity records and field sample extraction quotas（AQUIF）
information_points.content:
HYD-AQUIF-3K8：For the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan, confining layer penetration is not cleared for borehole cross-sections penetrating the regional aquitard, and the field sample extraction quota across the complete field borehole campaign is 180 samples.
HYD-AQUIF-W34：For the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan, confining layer penetration is cleared for borehole cross-sections penetrating the regional aquitard, and the field sample extraction quota across the complete field borehole campaign is 180 samples.
HYD-AQUIF-PGU：For the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan, confining layer penetration is cleared for borehole cross-sections penetrating the regional aquitard, and the field sample extraction quota across the complete field borehole campaign is 300 samples.

information_points.title: Aquifer pumping tests（PUMP）
information_points.content:
HYD-PUMP-XW6：Regarding aquifer pumping tests, the Continuous membrane interface probe transect plan demonstrates a sustainable pumping yield of 50 m^3/h across target test extraction wells.
HYD-PUMP-AWW：Regarding aquifer pumping tests, the High-resolution multi-level piezometer profiling plan demonstrates a sustainable pumping yield of 65 m^3/h across target test extraction wells.
HYD-PUMP-JMP：Regarding aquifer pumping tests, the Compound-specific isotope diffusion sampling plan demonstrates a sustainable pumping yield of 35 m^3/h across target test extraction wells.
